pageProps.title: Behind Closed Doors
pageProps.review: A review through the despair and fear experienced by the protagonist in B. A. Paris's novel, reflecting on the invisible tragedies of our society and providing a deep resonance about individual courage in responding to others' crises.
pageProps.description: The person you believe in is a psychopath
pageProps.content:
## Review The desperate emotions and fear of the female protagonist are felt intact. I felt frustrated throughout reading the book. Does it feel like being caught in a trap from which you cannot escape?
There must be many similar cases in the world we don't know about. No, there certainly are. It's just that we don't recognize them until an incident breaks out.
But I wonder if I would have the courage to help even if someone were in such a situation.
